description:
Admin only. Latest teasers plus already-generated images.

    Use ticker for all current items on a symbol, type for one content_type
    across symbols, or since for the worker poll. Then call
    marketing_graphics(content_id) for live formats. Reuse items[].images[]
    when the option you want is already rendered.

    Args:
        since: ISO timestamptz — inbox newer than this
        ticker: Current items for this symbol
        type: allowlisted content_type or research_drop
        limit: 1–200 (default 50)

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id
